scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Applies when the full Néron–Severi lattice is exactly \(\Lambda_2=U\oplus\langle-4\rangle\) and the specified elliptic fibration is present. Specializations with extra Néron–Severi classes are not covered. The genus-eight existence step uses the standard K3 basepoint-free criterion.
title: Minimum genus of trisections on a K3 surface with \(\Lambda_2\)
